final: WITH per_id AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), shares AS (SELECT ID, record_count, 1.0 * record_count / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share FROM per_id), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_record_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share.value) AS avg_excess_share FROM shares CROSS JOIN avg_share WHERE share > avg_share.value
